name: agentic-monday-apps-framework
description: SDLC toolkit for building monday.com code apps - from initialization to deployment

plugins.name: monday-code
plugins.description: Work with monday code projects (frontend/backend/fullstack) with proper structure, dependencies, and monday-code configuration

plugins.name: monday-api
plugins.description: Simplifies the monday.com public GraphQL API for external developers. Setup projects with the @mondaydotcomorg/api SDK, build and live-test queries, migrate between API versions, and operate in production with proper error handling, rate limits, and retries.
